title: BIRD: behavior-informed signals of customer dissatisfaction in technical-support dialogues
description: Code and protocol for a pilot study of customer dissatisfaction that sentiment polarity misses, on 90 dialogue prefixes from the public ABCD and MultiDoGO corpora. Includes deterministic, digest-checked collectors that rebuild the sample from the public releases, the annotation protocol and tests. Dialogue text, case-to-source mapping and case-level labels are not included.
